[LHYD.9.2] Kwargs on hydration calls:

| Kwarg | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `schema:` | yes (`hydrate_facts`) | schema name to query |
| `entity:` / `field:` | yes (`hydrate_samples`) | sample source |
| `window:` | yes | how far back to query |
| `as` | yes | correlation id (string) |
| `retain:` | yes | how long hydrated facts live |
| `limit:` | no | caller's result cap |
| `filter:` | no; not on the storage library's services ([LHYD.8.1]) | adapter-side predicate |
| `cooldown:` | yes (per the general `call` rule) | rate-limit on this hydration call |
